98:       const normalizedSegment = rawSegment.trim();

159:       let versionPathWithoutTrailingSlash = versionPath;

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getActiveVersion` (packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts:65): when the current version's path is `/`, its match-all route (`/docs/*`) is checked before versioned paths, so the active version always resolved to `current`, freezing the `docsVersionDropdown`.

The fix sorts versions so more-specific paths match first (a path containing another is tried first, mirroring core `sortRoutes()` logic), then finds the first `matchPath` match. Verified: all 12 `docsClientUtils.test.ts` cases pass (51 tests across the client suites), plus `tsc` and `eslint` are clean.
